$description: Baseline snapshot for scripts/check-surface.mjs. A container background inside src/components/ui/ must read a surface ROLE (bg-surface, bg-surface-card, bg-surface-canvas, bg-surface-field, bg-surface-row, text-surface-fg), never a static palette step, because base and alternative are places, not colors. Every hit here is recorded so the gate fails on NEW static fills. token-faithful = the token export itself declares a fixed palette step for that component, so the line is correct. pending-role = the line should read a role and is recorded as debt: fixing it changes dark-mode rendering, so it is a design decision, not a mechanical rewrite. The baseline may only shrink.
